reason: DeepSeekEyes primarily provides agent-driven browser and desktop automation with multimodal image interpretation and optional MCP application integration.

summaries.zh: DeepSeekEyes 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供图像理解、浏览器操作、跨平台桌面控制及可选 MCP 集成运行时。
summaries.en: DeepSeekEyes provides DeepSeek Harness with image understanding, browser actions, cross-platform desktop control, and optional MCP integrations.

capabilities: Routes images to multimodal models for visual understanding
Performs browser actions including opening pages, scrolling, clicking, typing, selecting, waiting, and verification
Controls Windows and macOS desktop interfaces through capture and native input mechanisms
Connects to configured MCP servers and exposes allowlisted tools, resources, and prompts
Records evidence, route health, failover, and token usage information
